title: AAT Architecten about
description: A short studio credo: a small portrait photo at the left, then one large paragraph whose first line starts where the photo ends, and an underlined 'more about us' link. The paragraph's lines rise out of masks one after another when it comes into view; the photo and the link fade in with the scroll.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: idle) for the line reveal; without it the paragraph simply shows
the scroll fade of the photo and link needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere they simply show
the photo slot is a muted placeholder until you pass media
name: aat-architecten-about
